questions.prompt: UTG opens, you are the small blind with KQo at 100bb. Best default?

choices.text: Fold or 3-bet. Do not flat out of position against a tight range.
Call. Offsuit broadways must flat the small blind.
Complete, because you posted a small blind.

questions.explanation: KQo is dominated by an early open and plays badly as a small-blind flat.

questions.prompt: Button opens to 2.5bb, you are the big blind with 76s and 100bb. A sound continue?

choices.text: Fold. Suited connectors are never defended.
Call. You are priced in and can hit a strong flop.
Limp, which does not apply after a raise.

questions.explanation: The big blind can defend suited connectors against a small button open and release when they miss.

questions.prompt: You are the small blind with AA. Someone has opened. Clear mistake?

choices.text: Raising larger because you are out of position

questions.explanation: Aces are never a fold to a single open.

questions.prompt: Both blinds called a late open and the flop is multiway. You should…

choices.text: Bluff every missed flop because you were in the blinds
Continue tighter. Multiway, bluffs and weak pairs lose value.

questions.explanation: Two blinds in the pot means you did not isolate. Make hands, do not blast air.
